create_PascalVOCDetectionEvaluator: create a PascalVOCDetectionEvaluator instance for a given dataset name like voc_2007_test
run_evaluate_mAP: run the evaluate method on PascalVOCDetectionEvaluator to compute mAP, AP50, and AP75 scores
process_detection_outputs: process model detection inputs and outputs to accumulate prediction strings per class
run_voc_eval: run voc_eval to compute recall, precision, and AP for a single class against ground truth annotations
parse_voc_xml_rec: parse a PASCAL VOC XML annotation file and return a list of object structs with bbox and metadata
